# GitHub About — copy-paste (English UI)

Paste into **Gear icon → Repository settings**, or edit the **About** section on the front page.

## Short Description (recommended, ≤350 characters)

```
ADNL multiplex tunnel: Android VPN + local SOCKS5, Windows C++ desktop client (TON-Tunnel/ + Wintun),
custom OPEN/DATA/CLOSE/ERROR frames over TON ADNL, Linux egress node. Optional libton_adnl_backend. AGPL-3.0.
```

**Shorter (one-line):**

```
TON ADNL tunnel — Android + Windows (C++/Wintun) clients + Linux egress. AGPL-3.0.
```
